identity.intro: Let's start with who you are. This shapes how I respond to you.

questions.prompt: What do you primarily build, run, or care for? In your own words — no need to be formal.
questions.example: Solo dev building AI tools. Two partners on a spa, married, one infant.

building.intro: What are you actually working on right now?

questions.prompt: If someone asked what you're focused on this month, what would you say?
questions.example: NEXUS V3 dispatcher rebuild + Legacy Leather maintenance.

values.intro: What matters to you? Not what should matter — what actually does.

questions.prompt: Three or four things you care about most. Family, work quality, faith, anything.

priorities.intro: When two important things conflict, which one wins?

questions.prompt: If your family needs you AND a deadline is the same day, which goes first?
questions.example: Family always wins over work deadlines unless production is on fire.

questions.prompt: What's the next thing that overrides everything except family?
questions.example: Health. If I'm sick or sleep-deprived, work waits.

decision_rules.intro: Rules you've made for yourself to avoid bad patterns.

questions.prompt: Two or three rules you try to follow. They can be simple.
questions.example: Sleep before deploys. Don't ship without three checks. No new SaaS without specific reason.

push_back.intro: When should I push back on you, even if you ask me to do something?

questions.prompt: Times you'd rather have me say 'wait' than just go along.
questions.example: When I'm tired. When I'm stacking new projects on top of unfinished ones. When I'm about to skip safety steps.
